card_01LNK.body:

card_01EDT.title: [devflow] Brief: Editing tasks
card_01EDT.body:
## Brief
- Goal: a task's title can be changed after it is added, and a finished task can be reopened.
- For whom: people who track their own work with `tasks` in the terminal.
- Success: `tasks rename 1 pay rent today` then `tasks show 1` prints the new title; `tasks undo` reopens the last task marked done; `make test` is green.
- Out of scope: moving a task to another list; an edit history; undoing anything but done.
- Constraints: the output of `tasks list` and `tasks show` stays the same.
- Decisions: rename takes the rest of the arguments as the title, as `add` does.

## Context
### Facts
- `main()` parses each command's options by hand in one if/elif chain (`src/tasks/cli.py:8`).
- The store loads and saves the whole JSON file on every command (`src/tasks/store.py:12`, `docs/adr/0001-one-json-file-store.md`).
### Test seam
- `main(argv, store, out)` with a store under `tmp_path`, exercised by `tests/test_cli.py`; the store alone by `tests/test_store.py`.
### Commands
- test: `make test` (`Makefile:1`), which runs `python3 -m pytest -q`.
### Boundaries
- Always: run `make test` before done (`AGENTS.md`).
- Ask first: changing where or how tasks are stored (`AGENTS.md`).
- Never: change the output of `tasks list` or `tasks show` without a flag (`AGENTS.md`).
### Assumptions I'm making
1. none
### Not confirmed
- none
### Glossary and ADRs
- none

card_01RNM.title: [devflow] tasks rename changes a task's title
card_01RNM.body:
## Build
`tasks rename <id> <new title>` changes the title of a task, and `tasks show` then prints the new one.

## Criteria
- [ ] `tasks rename 1 pay rent today` prints `renamed 1`, and `tasks show 1` then prints `title: pay rent today`
- [ ] `tasks rename 9 x` with no task 9 prints `rename: no task 9` and exits 1
- [ ] `tasks rename` without an id and a title prints `rename: give a task id and a new title` and exits 2

## Likely files
- src/tasks/cli.py
- src/tasks/store.py
- tests/test_cli.py

## Verify
`python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_cli.py -k rename`

## Blocked by
none
